Evidence: Bucket eviction deletes the FIRST key in insertion order, not least-recently-used; a still-active run bucket can be evicted while receiving spans

Impact: Silent span loss for active runs at scale
Proposed fix: LRU by last write (touch bucket on push) or documented ring semantics
